correctness.rationale: Independent rare Bernoulli indicators produce an intensity-c du/u Poisson process for rescaled logarithmic reversal times; the first two atoms are asymptotically distinct and the largest is below one. This proves the Beta(c,1) log exponent with no numerical-inference gap.

originality.rationale: The 2026 model explicitly includes the inverse-time/logarithm rate but does not state a ballistic-front deficit distribution. The 2019/2020 exact path scaling theorem already proves convergence to a random ray at smaller-than-inverse-time reversal rate, and is expressly acknowledged. The new statement resolves the invisible logarithmic frontier scale and exact joint reversal-time hierarchy. Search and implication comparisons did not identify a covering theorem, although general point-process theory may provide an implicit deduction.

value.rationale: The ballistic-ray weak limit cannot locate finite-time walkers within sublinear layers of their maximum displacement. The result determines the full power-law edge profile Pr(front gap <=N^z)->z^c and the ordered hierarchy of recent turn scales, a natural intrinsic rare-trajectory observable in the explicitly proposed logarithmically cooled persistent-walk regime. These are structurally motivated probability limits, not arbitrary parameter substitutions.
